title: Outstanding Claude work is forgotten across a host restart, so a check after the restart can earn credit while that work still runs
outcome: Outstanding and orphaned Claude work that may still be running survives a host restart, or is treated conservatively after it, so a check or carried gate that runs afterwards is not credited while that work may still write in its worktree.
acceptance: A test restarts the host while another session's Claude background work is outstanding in a worktree, then runs a check there, and shows the check is not credited while that work may still run, either because the outstanding work is restored or because the restart leaves the affected roots restricted until the work is proven ended.
The documented limitation in the feature doc is removed or rewritten to match the behaviour.
The full five-stage gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
